title: Agent Spending Without Controls — Rodrigo Coelho & Pranav Maheshwari, Edge & Node
talk_summary: The talk demos an agentic-commerce wallet/aggregator: a skill file gives Claude Code paid MCP tools, and a compliance layer screens/blocklists wallets before authorizing payments. It is mostly payments-infrastructure marketing, with no evidence about LLM-agent engineering efficiency.

takeaways.what_they_do: They route agent purchases through a wallet/aggregator that authorizes each transaction and can reject it based on compliance policy.
takeaways.evidence_quote: using compliance we are able to scan that and we are able to give you see over here the your your transactions are getting blocked or rejected

takeaways.what_they_do: They install one skill file that exposes paid MCP tools and handles payment in the background, instead of each agent configuring many paid MCP accounts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: all you need is a skill file installed in your agent

takeaways.what_they_do: Before authorizing an agent payment, they screen the wallet against sanctions/blocklist and reject flagged counterparties.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the reason behind the denying is because you're in the block listed wallet addresses
